agent_note: Third-person past narration; all 4 event quotes are past, none present. Yield is very low (4 of 23) because this quote page is dominated by courtroom/eulogy oratory selected for quotability. Quotation marks survive on only 5 of 23 quotes, so for the rest the dialogue call rests on person deixis (first-person 'I/we', second-person address), vocatives, rhetorical questions, and discourse markers ('You see', 'back to the Golden Rule'), all read against a narration that is uniformly third-person past where it appears. Four bare present-tense generalizations with no person deixis were kept gnomic. Under 5 event quotes, so this falls below the METHODOLOGY 'high confidence past' floor - insufficient, would need another page.
